release: Version-authority repair. 4.7.0 carries the SAME engine content as 4.6.0 — no functional change. 4.6.0 was burned as a version number on 2026-07-22 by an engine directory that reports 4.6.0 while containing 4.5.0 code, so the installed app compares 4.6.0 to 4.6.0, offers no update, and can never receive the published build. A new number is the only thing that can reach it.
